title: Separate approximation, estimation and optimization in the structural-prior crossover
supersedes_nothing: T14 and T20 (archived) are unchanged; the registered c/N law stays refuted and N* stays bracketed, not located.
question: What explains the crossover once the 1/N extrapolation has failed, without confounding nonseparability with spectrum or with optimizer quality?

risk_accounting.identity: the finite-sample class contrast separates into a population approximation cost, an estimation excess, and an optimization error
risk_accounting.benchmark_caveat: Relative to a merely best-found restricted projector, an alleged excess need not be nonnegative. An optimality-gap term is carried explicitly wherever certification is unavailable, and reported as an interval, not dropped.
risk_accounting.covariance_proxy: Monte-Carlo covariance proxy error is quantified separately from finite-training-sample error and from optimizer variability; the archived T20 conflated none of these but certified none either.

generator_requirement.goal: vary eigenvector and product geometry while holding designated eigenvalues, SNR, rank and sample sizes fixed
generator_requirement.validation_before_use: the intended nonseparability measure must be shown to change while the designated spectrum does not; if the constraint cannot be met, keep within-configuration claims only and record the failure
generator_requirement.prohibited: tuning the generator using confirmation outcomes

pilot.purpose: compare a small declared set of scaling explanations, including no parametric scaling assumption; select at most one model; never scored as confirmation

confirmation.purpose: fresh-seed test of the frozen selected model and a fixed-grid refinement of the existing N bracket

declared_scaling_candidates: no parametric scaling assumption (model-free bracket refinement)
selection_rule: chosen on pilot seeds only, by out-of-sample error on held-out pilot seeds; frozen before any confirmation seed is drawn; 1/N is not reinstated for convenience

bracket_refinement.grid: fixed before sampling, inside the archived 800-1600 bracket
bracket_refinement.contrasts: paired across methods on identical synthetic datasets
bracket_refinement.uncertainty: simultaneous over the grid, declared before sampling
bracket_refinement.reporting: tested sign brackets, never an exact crossover from interpolation; if signs are nonmonotone, report the profile rather than forcing a single crossing

record: valid lower and upper bounds where available
optimization_accounting.prohibited_claim: agreement among restarts is never reported as an optimality certificate

exit_criteria: a controlled comparison, or an explicit infeasibility finding
a fresh-seed bracket or model test with uncertainty
explicitly_not_claimed: broad universality of any scaling law
status: design frozen; execution conditional on remaining mission budget and time. If unexecuted, this package is reported as designed and deferred, not complete.
